informal_statement: The four-dimensional map whose zero solves the comparison equations.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MiddleFaceAssembly.lean:94-97, the source contract is `def rootMap (t : ℝ) (z : Vec4) : Vec4 := let p := pointOf t z ![-F b p, C4 b p, E b p, C3 b p]`. The map has four coordinates in the order (-F,C4,E,C3). The sign on F is essential: it converts positive F on the low xi face to the negative-low convention. The incidence and equal-area coordinates are not permuted.
